meta.competitor_category: Enterprise retail suite with a dedicated attribute extraction product
meta.headline: AttributeSmart generates the attributes. Oracle Retail consumes them.
meta.win_theme: Their extraction reads text. Lead with the image and label inputs their public material never claims.

how_to_use: Read the mechanism slide before the call. The technical detail is the wedge.
Establish whether they generate attributes or only consume them.
Use the matrix only when the buyer asks for a direct comparison.
Treat every Unclear rating as a question to ask, never as a gap to assert.
Log what the buyer confirms, so the next card carries fact instead of prompt.

snapshot.headquarters: A division of Oracle Corporation, not a standalone vendor. Take the corporate address from Oracle investor relations rather than a data broker.
snapshot.employees: Not published at division level. Oracle does not break out Retail headcount, so do not quote one.
snapshot.ownership: Public. A business unit of Oracle Corporation, NYSE ORCL.
snapshot.funding: No round to quote. Funded from Oracle operations.
snapshot.target_segment: Enterprise retailers, sold inside the Oracle Retail suite.
snapshot.deployment: Cloud services, per Oracle's own Merchandising Cloud Services naming.
snapshot.notable_customers: Oracle publishes retail references on its own site. Cite an Oracle page, not a tracker database, before naming a retailer on a call.
recent_moves: Category: Enterprise retail suite with a dedicated attribute extraction product
Their public claim: Machine learning extracts item attributes from free-form product descriptions and normalises the values, correcting short forms, misspellings and inconsistencies.
Refresh this quarterly. Every line needs a dated source.

positioning.their_claim: Machine learning extracts item attributes from free-form product descriptions and normalises the values, correcting short forms, misspellings and inconsistencies.
positioning.our_claim: CNN models take multiple product images, assign weights and biases, and identify attributes from the image itself. OCR reads packaging and label images, so attributes already printed on the pack never get retyped. NLP parses existing product descriptions and e-commerce copy, then harmonises the result when two sources disagree.
positioning.wedge: Their extraction reads descriptions. Ask what happens to a product that arrives as an image and a pack shot with no usable copy.

their_strengths: The only vendor on this list shipping a named attribute extraction product, so attribution is a funded roadmap item.
Extracted attributes feed demand transference, customer decision trees and advanced clustering inside AI Foundation.
Enterprise footprint and an existing data estate in most large retailers.
their_weaknesses: Public material describes extraction from free-form descriptions. It does not claim image or label based extraction. Confirm on the call.
No published attribute library depth for fashion or food. Ask for the number.
No published synonym, SEO or trend attribute capability. Ask how search terms reach the catalogue.

our_advantages.title: Three inputs, not one
our_advantages.detail: CNN models take multiple product images, assign weights and biases, and identify attributes from the image itself. OCR reads packaging and label images, so attributes already printed on the pack never get retyped.
our_advantages.proof: Accuracy of 65 to 96 percent once all three inputs ran. IA AttributeSmart NRF 2026 deck

our_advantages.title: A library, not a mapper
our_advantages.detail: A pre-trained library of 10,000 plus fashion and home attributes, curated by retail experts, plus 400 plus food tags maintained against FDA packaging guidance. Derived attributes go beyond what the pack states, using FDA labelling guidance and external data to infer diet, allergen, wellness and clean label attributes.
our_advantages.proof: 10,000 plus attributes for fashion and home, 400 plus food tags. IA AttributeSmart NRF 2026 deck

our_advantages.title: Built for the merchant, not the model
our_advantages.detail: Reviews are prioritised by model confidence, so merchants spend their time on the tags the model ranks as least certain. APIs and file exports push into PIM, MDM, ERP, CMS and e-commerce systems, or a single API serves the attributes.
our_advantages.proof: 60 percent cost saving on manual attribution. IA AttributeSmart NRF 2026 deck

objections.response: Ask which inputs it reads. If the answer is descriptions, the gap is every product that arrives as an image or a pack shot. Offer to tag that subset in two weeks.
objections.proof: A retailer moved accuracy from 65 percent to 96 percent once image and label inputs were included. IA AttributeSmart NRF 2026 deck

objections.objection: We want one vendor for planning and attribution.
objections.response: AttributeSmart writes back into the PIM and the planning stack, so the attributes improve without replacing either. Price the margin the better data unlocks.
objections.proof: Integration into PIM, MDM, ERP and CMS is standard. IA AttributeSmart NRF 2026 deck

landmines.question: How does the model attribute a product that arrives with images and no description?
landmines.why: Text-only extraction has no answer to an image-first catalogue.
landmines.listen_for: A manual process, or a supplier chase.

landmines.question: How many attributes does the pre-trained library hold for your categories?
landmines.why: Library depth separates a real taxonomy from a field mapper.
landmines.listen_for: A number in the hundreds, or no number at all.

landmines.question: Who adds the words shoppers actually search but suppliers never send?
landmines.why: Synonym and trend tagging is a discovery capability, not an extraction one.
landmines.listen_for: The e-commerce team doing it by hand.

questions: Which team creates a new product attribute today?
How many minutes per product does that take?
What happens when a supplier sends an image and nothing else?
What share of your attributes carry at least one error?
How much of your product data goes unused because it is not standardised?
Who notices first when an attribute is wrong?
Which decision breaks first when attributes are thin, forecast or search?
What did poor product discovery cost you in conversion last quarter?

talk_track.positioning: For retailers whose product data blocks every downstream decision, AttributeSmart generates deep, standardised attributes from images, labels and text, so forecasting, assortment and search all run on data merchants trust.
talk_track.elevator: AttributeSmart reads your product images, your pack labels and your descriptions, then writes back a standardised attribute set. Accuracy went from 65 percent to 96 percent at one retailer, and manual attribution cost dropped 60 percent.
talk_track.discovery_open: How many minutes does a merchant spend per product today entering and correcting attributes?
talk_track.trap: Ask where their attributes come from when a supplier sends an image and nothing else.

dos: Lead with the attribute error rate the buyer already measures.
Separate generating attributes from consuming them. That line is the deal.
Offer the two week proof on their own catalogue, 100,000 products.
Name the downstream decision the bad data is breaking, then price that.
Cite the source for every number, including ours.
donts: Do not claim a rival lacks a capability you have not verified on the call.
Do not position against the planning suite. Most of these deals sit alongside one.
Do not quote competitor pricing or roadmap.
Do not send this card outside Impact Analytics.
Do not present a comparison row marked Unclear as though it were a gap.

pricing.ia_model: Subscription scoped by category and catalogue size, with services scoped per phase. Confirm the current model with deal desk before you quote.
pricing.competitor_model: Record only what the buyer states or the vendor publishes. Nothing here is sourced.
notes: Never quote a rival price you cannot source.
Price the cost of staying: manual hours plus the margin the bad data is losing.

next_steps: Run the two week proof: 100,000 products from their own catalogue.
Agree the accuracy metric and the readout date before the test starts.
Confirm which downstream system consumes the attributes first, PIM or planning.
